newsitem.title: UK: Sears in talks with Littlewoods on Freemans.
newsitem.headline: Sears in talks with Littlewoods on Freemans.

text.p: British retailer Sears Plc confirmed on Monday it was in advanced discussions with the privately-owned Littlewoods Organisation on the sale of Sears' Freemans home shopping business.
Freemans is Britain's third largest mail order business and several companies, including two from France and Germany are thought to have been interested in buying.
Sears did not disclose further details of its talks with Littlewoods other than to say that any sale would be conditional on shareholder approval and avoidance of a monopolies referral.
